relations.subject: manage:manage-indexes
relations.evidence: status. The current state of the Index Service on the node on which this index is stored. The state can be expressed as **ready**, **pause**, **warmup**, or **n mutations remaining** (where **n** is an integer).

notable_absence.finding: This page - which covers creating, dropping, and editing indexes via the Web Console Query Editor, plus CLI and REST management of Index-Service settings - has no RBAC/privileges section anywhere, despite covering the same underlying operations (CREATE INDEX, DROP INDEX) that the N1QL statement-reference pages document as requiring the Query Manage Index privilege. This is the same pattern noted for search/fts task pages in an earlier batch: task/UI-oriented how-to pages tend not to restate the privilege requirements that the underlying statement-reference pages document, even when the UI is just a front end for that same statement.
